headlines.title: Why the traditional 60/40 portfolio might be dead
headlines.summary: Catalyst Funds Chief Investment Officer David Miller and Washington Crossing Advisors Senior Portfolio Manager Chad Morganlander chat about the reality of the 60/40 portfolio in today's volatile economy, and break down why traditional investing strategies might fail you as interest rates rise and the national debt skyrockets.

headlines.title: Visa (V) Turns Scale Into Best-in-Class Margins. Here Is What Investors Need to Know
headlines.summary: With growing prominence of digital wallets, stablecoins, and account-to-account payments, Visa Inc. (NYSE:V) plans to increase its relevance in the evolving ecosystem by expanding beyond its conventional card payments network. The stock is up 2.84% on year-to-date basis and 4.25% over the past 52 weeks.

headlines.title: Visa vs. Mastercard: Does a 241% Return on Equity Make Mastercard the Better Buy?
headlines.summary: Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE:MA) reports a much higher return on equity than Visa Inc. (NYSE:V). At October 5, trailing figures were about 241% and 61%, respectively. That striking difference invites a simple conclusion: Mastercard must be the better business. The balance sheets and share prices require a more careful answer.

headlines.title: OpenTable and Visa Extend Their Agreement in the U.S., Mexico and Canada
headlines.summary: OpenTable, a global leader in restaurant technology, and Visa, a world leader in digital payments, today announced a renewed agreement across the U.S., Mexico and Canada. The next phase will broaden the Visa Dining Collection in Mexico and Canada and deliver an expanded events program, giving eligible Visa cardholders more ways to discover and book memorable dining experiences across the three countries.

headlines.title: Nearly half of Asia Pacific consumers open to stablecoins, Visa finds
headlines.summary: The study surveyed 14,250 consumers aged 18 to 65 across 14 Asia Pacific markets.

description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
